sentences.en: I would be grateful for your approval of this request.
sentences.zh: 能获得您对这项请求的批准我将不胜感激。

sentences.en: This bill was sent to the Senate for its approval.
sentences.zh: 该法案已提交参议院审议。

sentences.en: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
sentences.zh: 如果您同意的话，我想给他提供这个职位。

senses.zh: 赞同，同意；批准，认可；好评，称许；（正式的）许可，批准
